events.title: Investigation assessment
events.detail: The checkout incident is currently unresolvable due to missing origin diagnostics. All recovery actions are blocked by policy because origin logs and request traces are unavailable. Historical outcomes indicate that disabling the payments feature flag in v2.4 could resolve legacy currency incompatibility, but this requires confirmation of current deployment, ledger schema, and feature flag status. Without verified diagnostic evidence, no action is justified. The full blast radius of failure includes storefront, checkout, payments, ledger, and inventory via dependency chains. A root cause analysis is impossible without origin-level telemetry.

INC-2043
data.summary: Checkout requests return HTTP 503. Origin telemetry is unavailable.

Checkout failure originates in payments v2.4's strict_currency_validation rejecting legacy currency strings. Ledger schema 1 advisory permits rollback to payments v2.3. Graph impact shows all services from storefront to notifications are affected via dependency chains. Rollback is supported by current compatibility policy.

Payments v2.4's strict_currency_validation is enabled but incompatible with legacy currency strings. Ledger schema 2 is active, blocking rollback to v2.3. The current compatibility advisory permits disabling the validation flag in payments without rolling back. This action restores legacy currency acceptance while maintaining payments v2.4 and ledger schema 2. All downstream services—checkout, storefront, inventory, and notifications—are affected via dependency chains. The proposed action is supported by the migration policy and runtime configuration.
